# billyharness

> Fast solo-owner Go agent harness with gateway, TUI, Telegram adapter, JSONL
> replay, compact native tools, lazy MCP, and Codex/DeepSeek provider paths.
> Read AGENTS.md first. `docs/` is architecture-only; active implementation
> state lives in `loop-develop/current-todo`.

## Start Here

- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): project rules, verification, docs policy,
  and workflow routing.
- [README](README.md): project overview and basic usage.
- [Loop workflow](loop-develop/README.md): current/history TODO rules.

## Agent Rules

- [Agent rules index](.agents/rules/README.md): detailed read triggers.
- [Documentation rule](.agents/rules/documentation.md): how agents read, write,
  and verify documentation.
- [Stop hook docguard](.agents/rules/stop-hook-docguard.md): installed
  project-local Codex `Stop` hook behavior for fast documentation drift checks.

## Architecture Canon

- [Docs index](docs/README.md): architecture docs only.
- [Architecture map](docs/architecture.md): package ownership, guarded imports,
  and file-size budgets.
- [Gateway and sessions](docs/architecture/gateway-and-sessions.md): gateway
  HTTP/session routes, durable store, replay/follow semantics, and
  gateway-client authority boundaries.
- [Security and trust model](docs/architecture/security-model.md): gateway and
  browser trust, bearer auth, Telegram allowlists, MCP untrusted input, tool
  policy, workspace boundaries, secret redaction, and public-web protections.
- [Runtime event system](docs/architecture/runtime-event-system.md):
  source-of-truth event model, JSONL replay, lifecycle validation, runtime IDs,
  output refs, and compaction/context events.
- [TUI and client UX architecture](docs/architecture/tui-and-clientux.md):
  TUI event projection, transcript cells, rendering, selection/copy, saved
  sessions, and local runtime adapter boundaries.
- [Config/provider/context architecture](docs/architecture/config-provider-context.md):
  config provenance, runtime overrides, providers/auth, model capabilities,
  instructions, memory, skills, and context accounting.
- [Tools, MCP, webtools, and rendering boundaries](docs/architecture/tools-mcp-and-policy.md):
  native tool registry, tool policy, lazy MCP, public web access, output refs,
  and client rendering boundaries.
- [Telegram and operator surfaces](docs/architecture/telegram-and-operator-surfaces.md):
  Telegram adapter, gateway-client boundary, owner scope, rendering,
  attachments, command flow, and operator/security constraints.
- [Documentation system](docs/documentation-system.md): documentation hierarchy,
  source-of-truth rules, generated-doc markers, and drift prevention.
- [ADR index](docs/adr/README.md): decision-record rules and template.

## Machine Indexes

- [Docs manifest](agent-index/docs-manifest.json): metadata, trust level,
  freshness hints, and read triggers.
- [Agent index README](agent-index/README.md): generated/manual index policy.
- [Generated reference strategy](agent-index/generated/reference-plan.md):
  future docsgen outputs, generated markers, temp-dir diff checks, source globs,
  and docguard coverage.
- [Generated repo map](agent-index/generated/repo-map.md): compact package
  orientation map for agents.

## Coverage Note

This map is initial and not exhaustive. Generated CLI/API/config/protocol/tool
references are planned in
[agent-index/generated/reference-plan.md](agent-index/generated/reference-plan.md)
but are not implemented yet; use source code for exact surfaces. `ops/` has
seed runbooks, while live unit files, environment, logs, and host state still
need production inspection before being treated as verified.

- [Doctor and diagnostics](ops/doctor-and-diagnostics.md): doctor, config,
  gateway readiness, MCP, session diagnostic commands, and incident bundles.
- [Production services](ops/production-services.md): production entrypoint,
  service names, readiness checks, restart flow, and redaction cautions.
